summary.text: Jeff Helfrich is the Republican candidate for Oregon Senate District 26 in the November 3, 2026 general election and currently serves as a state representative for Oregon House District 52.
He is a U.S. Air Force veteran and former police officer who lives in Hood River.

paragraphs.text: Jeffrey Helfrich lives in Hood River, Oregon, and served in the U.S. Air Force.
His career experience includes working as a police officer, and he served on the Cascade Locks City Council.
Helfrich represented Oregon House District 52 from 2017 to 2019, succeeding Mark Johnson, and returned to the seat in January 2023.
He served as House minority leader from September 2023 to November 2024, and in the 2023-2024 session he was vice chair of the House Housing Committee.
He is not running for re-election to the House, and he advanced from the Republican primary for Senate District 26 on May 19, 2026.
